name: India daily electricity demand x weather (8 large states)
description: REAL outcome from a non-health system: daily electricity supplied to 8 large Indian states (Grid-India, 2019 to Apr 2024), joined to state-level ERA5 weather (Hunt and Bloomfield, Zenodo 14983362, CC BY 4.0). The outcome is the % above each state's own trend, season and weekday. Measures grid stress, not health.
